title: Trace Event v0.1
description: The wire format for every observability event emitted by a runtime engine (ADR-013), a technology adapter (ADR-014), or the platform kernel. Trace events are the substrate for the Trace Viewer — they must be able to answer 'why did this field appear?', 'why did this rule fire?', and 'why did this side effect happen?'. Every event references a declared `eventKindRef` from the CAM ObservabilityModel; unknown kinds are refused at load time. Payload shape depends on the eventKind and is validated by the Observability Runtime against a per-kind JSON Schema (published separately in Phase 1). Redaction of PII/sensitive-pii fields per CAM SecurityModel.dataClassifications is captured in `redactions` for audit integrity.

traceEventVersion.description: Version of this trace-event envelope. Currently '0.1'. A change to the envelope shape is a major bump per ADR-012.

id.description: Globally unique event id. Produced by the emitter, never re-used.

eventKindRef.description: Must match a `traceEventKinds[].id` in the loaded CAM's ObservabilityModel.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event happened. Supplied by the Observability Runtime via injected clock (ADR-013 determinism). Never wall-clock inside an engine.

traceId.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id (16-byte hex). Propagated across engines and adapters unchanged.

correlationId.description: Business-level correlation across an entire user-visible action (e.g., one submit-onboarding). Echoed from the triggering EffectDescriptor.

causationId.description: id of the trace event that directly caused this one. Chains reconstruct the causal DAG.

subjectId.description: Opaque, non-PII subject identifier (e.g., hash of applicant id). Never the raw email or legal name.

camVersion.description: MetadataModel.appVersion of the CAM in force when the event was emitted.

severity.description: Trace-event severity. Distinct from Diagnostic severity (ADR-013). An `error` trace event does NOT necessarily indicate an operation failure — it may record an expected failure that the diagnostic already covers.

payload.description: Event-kind-specific data. Shape is validated by the Observability Runtime against a per-kind JSON Schema fragment (see follow-up: Trace Event Kind Registry, Phase 1). At v0.1 the envelope treats it as open — the runtime enforces shape.

redactions.description: Every field elided or masked in `payload` per CAM SecurityModel.dataClassifications. Empty array MUST be present when nothing was redacted, so consumers can distinguish 'none redacted' from 'redaction not run'.

reproducibilityHash.description: REQUIRED on adapter-produced events per ADR-014. Sha256 over the canonicalized adapter inputs (effect descriptor after redaction + relevant adapter config). Enables replay comparison and detection of adapter reproducibility incidents.

attributes.description: Free-form key-value attributes for OpenTelemetry export. Values must be scalar (string, number, boolean) or arrays of scalars.

allOf.$comment: Adapter events MUST carry a reproducibilityHash per ADR-014.

producer.$comment: Discriminated on `kind`. Runtime engines use their name from the ADR-013 enum; adapters use their identity from ADR-014; the kernel and its subsystems use their well-known name.
